description: Source code for a Git credential helper that interfaces with Windows' Credential Manager, including functions for reading, writing, matching, and managing credentials, as well as command-line handling.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the program.

methods.name: target_append
methods.description: Appends a string to the target buffer, checking for overflow.

methods.name: wcsstr_last
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring in a wide string.

methods.name: match_part_with_last
methods.description: Matches a part of a target string with optional delimiter and last occurrence.

methods.name: match_part
methods.description: Matches a part of a target string with a delimiter.

methods.name: match_part_last
methods.description: Matches a part of a target string with a delimiter, searching from the end.

methods.name: match_cred_password
methods.description: Checks if credential password matches the stored password.

methods.name: match_cred
methods.description: Checks if a credential matches the current parameters.

methods.name: get_credential
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from Windows Credential Manager.

methods.name: store_credential
methods.description: Stores credentials into Windows Credential Manager.

methods.name: erase_credential
methods.description: Deletes credentials from Windows Credential Manager.

methods.name: utf8_to_utf16_dup
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16 wide string.
